name: OpenDonut
description: Makes several independent Fabric servers behave like one continuous world. Detects when a player crosses the boundary of the region their server owns and asks the Velocity proxy to move them to the server that owns their new global coordinates.

opendonut:notes: This mod is useless without the matching OpenDonut Velocity plugin: it sends authenticated
